It was the EWR to MIA segment—HAT202. That’s the one where we had to wait for a really long time. Is there anything you can do for us because of that delay?
Yes, please go ahead and check. I’d appreciate it if you could process the compensation if the delay is confirmed. Thank you for helping with this.

I don’t have any documentation with me right now, just the memory of waiting at the airport for hours. Is there anything else you can do, or any way to check with the airport or airline staff? It was really frustrating, and I’d appreciate any help you can offer.
